current.delivery_attention: Delivery evidence for the effective version needs attention

owners.inspected: Operation status inspected; not permission to execute

result.readbackUnknown: No verified readback for this data
result.testWriteReadback: Test-write readback verified (not normal data-row readback)
result.devicePending: Devices retain operations not attributed to this page. Inspect them in their original settings.
result.detailsFor: Evidence details and observation time for {{name}}

source.sharedDescription: These settings are shared sources. Changes apply only when explicitly saved.
source.emptyRanges: This device has no saved read ranges.
source.discardDescription: Discard only these unsent changes? Previously saved sources will remain.
source.saved: Range saved. You can keep editing or close.
source.saving: Saving. Please wait; the submitted change cannot be canceled.
source.unknown: The save acknowledgement is unavailable. Do not submit again. Read the current saved values or leave without claiming the change was canceled.
source.stale: The saved range changed or could not be verified. Your unsent changes remain here. Close and reopen to review the current range.
source.unavailable: This device or read range is unavailable. No changes have been sent.
source.prefixImpact: The saved range label is its point-name prefix. Changing it may change generated point names; there is no separate saved display name.
source.leaveSent: Leave without canceling the submitted change

currentRead.available: Current saved values were read. This does not prove whether the original request succeeded.
currentRead.unavailable: Current saved values could not be read. The original request remains unconfirmed.

fields.addressHint: First address in the device register map, for example {{example}}.
fields.addressUnknown: Use the address format documented for this device.
fields.countHint: For example, 16 values. Count data items, not register words.
fields.typeHint: Use the data type specified by the device register map.
fields.prefixHint: For example, TEMP_. This becomes part of each generated point name.

source.rangesUnavailable: The read ranges of this device could not be read. No changes have been sent.
source.activationNotReady: This device has not passed its connection and read tests. Turn off the rule to save offline, or test the connection before saving it enabled.
source.shareOff: Global Modbus Share is off. Enable it in global settings, then return here.
source.shareUnknown: Global Modbus Share status is unconfirmed. Refresh before configuring this rule.

presentation.noRanges: No saved ranges in this area

memory.title: Memory view
memory.heading: Address areas
memory.introShort: Tap an empty cell to add a range; tap a used cell to edit it.
memory.intro: Each address area is shown separately. Select an empty address to start a new read range there, or a used address to open its saved range. Nothing is saved until you save the range form.
memory.locateInvalid: That address is not in the {{area}} area.

cell.empty: {{address}}, empty, start a new read range here
cell.partial: , the span after this address cannot be confirmed

issue.string-width: {{label}}: string point spans differ between this screen (10 registers) and the saved-point planner (1 register), so free addresses in this area cannot be confirmed.
issue.bit-width: {{label}}: a multi-register type on a bit area has no confirmed footprint, so free addresses in this area cannot be confirmed.
issue.list-scope: This range list has no valid workspace revision, so saved MC points cannot be confirmed and no free address can be offered. Read the ranges again.
issue.mc-scope: {{label}}: this range list has no valid workspace revision, so saved MC points cannot be confirmed in any area.
issue.mc-proof: {{label}}: the saved MC points for this workspace revision could not be confirmed, so free addresses in this area cannot be confirmed.
issue.invalid-rule: {{label}}: the saved start address or count cannot be read by the address rules, so free addresses cannot be confirmed.
issue.out-of-range: {{label}}: the saved range runs past this area's address limit, so free addresses in this area cannot be confirmed.

blocked.recovery: A new read range save is still unconfirmed. Resolve it from Add read range before choosing a free address; free addresses cannot be confirmed.
blocked.local: Some range changes on this page have not been saved, so free addresses cannot be confirmed.
blocked.stale: The saved ranges changed since this page loaded, so free addresses cannot be confirmed. Close and reopen to read the current ranges.

memory.readFailed: Saved ranges could not be read, so no memory cells are shown. Nothing was changed.
memory.unsupported: This device's address format has no memory map here.
memory.ownersTitle: {{address}} belongs to several ranges. Choose the range to open.

value.error: Device values could not be read; cells keep the last values received.
value.live: Live device values, refreshed every second (on-screen cells only).
value.polling: Live connection unavailable; refreshing every second.
value.liveUpdated: Live · every second · updated {{time}} · on-screen cells only
value.pollingUpdated: Live connection unavailable · refreshing every second · updated {{time}}

memory.prefilled: Starting address {{address}} was filled in from the memory view. Set the count and format, then save.

locator.localDescription: Only this selected device or record is loaded. Open full advanced setup for the complete four-step workflow.
locator.finishBeforeLeaving: Finish the current changes before leaving. Your edits are kept here.
locator.readUnavailable: The current settings could not be confirmed. Your edits are retained below, but editing is paused until the read succeeds.

devicesPurpose: Devices define connections and the values to read. Use Connection or Read points to change a device.
recordingsPurpose: Recordings choose which device values to save, and their destination database.
deviceCreationHint: To add a device: New recording → Choose points → Add source → Create a new device.

deliverySummary.unconfirmed: Recording status has not been confirmed
deliverySummary.blocked: Intake is retiring or blocked; resolve the issues shown
deliverySummary.backlog: Rows from an earlier revision are still pending. Updating settings does not retarget them.

acquisitionAnomalies.title: Acquisition anomalies · {{device}}
acquisitionAnomalies.description: Disconnections, points that stopped updating and frozen values recorded for this device, newest first. They mark periods when collected data was unreliable; settings and recordings are not changed.
acquisitionAnomalies.empty: No acquisition anomalies recorded for this device.
acquisitionAnomalies.pageEmpty: This page has no events any more. Older events may have been removed.

errors.invalid_filter: The anomaly filter was rejected. Clear the filters and try again.
errors.device_not_found: This device no longer exists. Close this window and refresh the device list.
errors.capability_unavailable: Acquisition anomaly records are not available on this gateway. Check the runtime setup.
errors.unavailable: Unable to read acquisition anomalies right now. Retry in a moment.
errors.malformed_response: The gateway returned an unreadable anomaly response. Retry; if it persists, check the gateway version.
errors.unknown: Unable to read acquisition anomalies. Check the connection to the gateway and retry.

sources.stale: Showing previously observed sources. Current sources could not be verified. Retry to check again.
sources.error: Source refresh failed. Previously observed sources may be out of date. Retry to check again.
sources.unknown: Sources could not be verified. Retry to check again.
